title: Concept: SVG image reference on plaintext HTTP
description: An svg image element that points at plaintext HTTP in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The referenced graphic is unauthenticated, so what the customer sees next to a confirmation can be changed on the path.
applicability: Deployments that render an svg image element that points at plaintext HTTP into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The referenced graphic is unauthenticated, so what the customer sees next to a confirmation can be changed on the path.
